decision.trend: Research on high-entropy alloys (HEAs) has been focused on understanding their structural and chemical stability under various operating conditions, including catalytic and thermoelectric ranges. The studies have explored different processing routes, such as mechanical alloying, spark plasma sintering, and laser cladding, to achieve desired microstructures and properties. The trend shows that HEAs can exhibit superior mechanical properties, corrosion resistance, and radiation resistance compared to traditional alloys. However, the maintenance of stability across operating ranges remains a challenge, and further research is needed to understand the underlying mechanisms.
